name: Chemical Safety training VR
summary:
Chemical Safety Training VR is a hands-on, single-user VR safety training program designed to help users properly inspect, select, and wear personal protective equipment (PPE) before entering a chemical handling site. This app supports Korean only.

It offers two scenarios:
  - PPE before entering a confined space
  - PPE for responding to a chemical spill
